{{Short description|72nd season of the National Hurling League}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox GAA League |league = 2003 National Hurling League |image = |dates = 22 February 2003 – 5 May 2003 |teams = 32 |team1 = Kilkenny |captain1 = [[Charlie Carter (hurler)|Charlie Carter]] |manager1 = [[Brian Cody]] |titles = 11th |team2 = Tipperary |captain2 = [[Brian O'Meara (Mullinahone hurler)|Brian O'Meara]] |manager2 = [[Michael Doyle (hurler)|Michael Doyle]] |oneb = |two = Antrim |twob = |three = Mayo |threeb = |previous = [[2002 National Hurling League|2002]] |next = [[2004 National Hurling League|2004]] }} The '''2003 National Hurling League''' was the 72nd seasons of the [[National Hurling League]]. ==Division 1== {{Infobox football league season |competition=[[National Hurling League|National Hurling League Division 1]] |season=2003 |winners=[[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]]

(13 April 2003) |highest scoring= |matches= 49 |total goals= |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest winless= |longest losses= |highest attendance= |lowest attendance= |attendance= |average attendance= |prevseason=[[2002 National Hurling League|2002]] |nextseason=[[2004 National Hurling League|2004]] |updated=26 April 2017 }} [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] came into the season as defending champions of the [[2002 National Hurling League|2002 season]]. [[Laois GAA|Laois]] entered Division 1 as the promoted team. On 5 May 2003, Kilkenny won the title following a 5–14 to 5–13 win over [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] in the final.{{cite web|url=http://www.independent.ie/sport/hurling/stunning-kilkenny-snatch-and-grab-raid-25945806.html|title=Stunning Kilkenny snatch and grab raid|publisher=Irish Independent|date=6 May 2003|accessdate=26 April 2017}} It was their [[2002 National Hurling League|second league title in succession]] and their 11th National League title overall. [[Derry GAA|Derry]], who lost all of their group stage matches, were relegated from Division 1 after losing all of their matches in the relegation group. [[Antrim GAA|Antrim]] won Division 2 and secured promotion to the top tier.
